### Dataset:

Edges represent co-purchase relationships — two products are connected if customers frequently buy them together.

narrative: The GNN model predicted that the product "Lehigh 540W 230-Feet Polypropylene Heavy Duty Twine, Brown" belongs to the "Arts, Crafts & Sewing" category with a confidence of 49.76%. The presence of the word "heavy" and "line" in the product description significantly contributed to this prediction, aligning well with items used in crafting and sewing activities, although other top words like "project" and "round" were absent. The model also considered the direct co-purchase relationship with another "Arts, Crafts & Sewing" product, the "Darice 5-Ply Craft Designer Jute, Natural," indicating a strong association with crafting materials. Furthermore, the 2-hop neighbors, such as "Surgical Steel Earring Earwires Hypoallergenic Shiny Silver Plated Fishhook," often purchased with craft supplies, support this categorization. The absence of some words like "project" and "stereo" did not deter the model’s confidence, as the co-purchase pattern predominantly ties the twine to arts and crafts uses. Overall, the influential product connections, alongside specific relevant vocabulary, lead the model to classify the twine within the crafting category.
